prompt: With spot1, patrol between stop_a and stop_b for 3 hours, 20 minutes at stop_b each round. The moment your battery drops below 20 percent, even in the middle of a round, go to charger_1 and charge, then carry on patrolling.

expect_2_4.because: 0048 S10 (G-TRIGGER: a self-state trigger fires at the moment; a mission starts a run only when the last one is done, 0041 M6)

why: A self-state trigger (0048 S10, 0041 M6, G-TRIGGER): the charge is to be acted on at the moment it drops, even inside a round. A check at the start of each run only sees it at the next run, which is a different request. Under 2.3 the attempt fails at the kind (`E217`).
